g.text: Type the remote app's port + Enter, or press A for a form. ? explains ports.
This computer: http://localhost:8000 -> Remote app: port 8000
Press B to open a web app. ON means the connection is listening; the remote app must also be
Ready. Select a favorite and press Enter, or just type a port.
Keeps running when Terminal closes. S stops connections; Q closes this screen.
